propositions.name: aether_exists
propositions.statement: The interactions between atoms are necessitated by the aether, whose properties are revealed in electric and optical phenomena.
propositions.quote: the interactions between atoms are in very great part those necessitated by the aether whose properties are revealed in electric and optical phenomena

propositions.name: electron_nucleus_point_singularity
propositions.statement: The nucleus of the electron is merely a singular point in the aether, with nothing in it of the nature of inertia foreign to the aether.
propositions.quote: this statement implies that the nucleus of the electron is merely a singular point in the aether, that there is nothing involved in it of the nature of inertia foreign to the aether

propositions.name: no_forces_other_than_electric
propositions.statement: There are no forces between electrons other than those that exist through the mediation of the aether, that is other than electric forces.
propositions.quote: it also implies that there are no forces between the electrons other than those that exist through the mediation of the aether as here defined, that is other than electric forces

propositions.name: moving_frame_equations_same_form
propositions.statement: The scheme of equations referred to moving axes is identical in form with the Maxwellian scheme of relations for the aethereal vectors referred to fixed axes.
propositions.quote: the scheme of equations, referred to moving axes, which connects together the new variables with subscripts, is identical in form with the Maxwellian scheme of relations for the aethereal vectors referred to fixed axes

propositions.name: contraction_of_moving_system
propositions.statement: Imparting to a steady material system a uniform velocity of translation produces a uniform contraction of the system in the direction of the motion.
propositions.quote: an effect of imparting to a steady material system a uniform velocity of translation is to produce a uniform contraction of the system in the direction of the motion

propositions.name: electron_field_dominated_by_own_electron
propositions.statement: No matter what other electrons are present, the wholly preponderating part of the aethereal vector near an electron belongs to the adjacent electron.
propositions.quote: no matter what other electrons are present, this argument still applies if the surface be taken to surround the electron under consideration very closely

propositions.name: electron_strength_invariant_under_motion
propositions.statement: Motion of a material system containing electrons cannot alter the strengths of the electrons.
propositions.quote: since motion of a material system containing electrons cannot alter their strengths

propositions.name: wavefronts_and_rays_correspond
propositions.statement: The relative wave-fronts of radiation correspond, as also do the rays which are the paths of the radiant energy, in the two correlated systems.
propositions.quote: the relative wave-fronts of radiation correspond, as also do the rays which are the paths of the radiant energy relative to the systems

propositions.name: doppler_effect_on_wavelength
propositions.statement: The change of the time variable, in the comparison of radiations in the fixed and moving systems, involves the Doppler effect on the wave-length.
propositions.quote: The change of the time variable, in the comparison of radiations in the fixed and moving systems, involves the Doppler effect on the wave-length

propositions.name: fresnel_effect_with_second_order_correction
propositions.statement: The velocity of the wave-train relative to the moving medium includes the Fresnel effect and a second order correction, on the hypothesis which includes Michelson's negative result.
propositions.quote: The second term in this expression is the Fresnel effect, and the remaining term is its second order correction on our hypothesis which includes Michelson's negative result

propositions.name: no_effect_of_earths_motion_on_optics
propositions.statement: The correspondence of regions of no disturbance carries the general absence of effect of the Earth's motion in optical experiments, up to the second order of small quantities.
propositions.quote: this result carries the general absence of effect of the Earth's motion in optical experiments, up to the second order of small quantities

propositions.name: electrons_opposite_signs_orbit_model
propositions.statement: A molecule may be illustrated by a group formed of a pair of electrons of opposite signs describing steady circular orbits round each other in a position of rest.
propositions.quote: let us consider the group formed of a pair of electrons of opposite signs describing steady circular orbits round each other in a position of rest

propositions.name: orbits_flattened_by_motion
propositions.statement: When a pair of electrons is moving through the aether with velocity v in the plane of their orbits, the orbits are flattened along the direction of v.
propositions.quote: when this pair is moving through the aether with velocity v in a direction lying in the plane of their orbits, these orbits relative to the translatory motion will be flattened along the direction of v

propositions.name: period_changed_only_second_order
propositions.statement: On the whole, the period of the orbital motion is changed only in the second-order ratio by the translatory motion.
propositions.quote: so that on the whole the period will be changed only in the second-order ratio

propositions.name: fields_symmetric_fore_aft_unaltered_first_order
propositions.statement: The aethereal fields of the moving electric charges existing in the molecule are symmetrical fore and aft and unaltered to the first order by the motion.
propositions.quote: the aethereal fields of the moving electric charges, free or constrained, existing in the molecule, will be symmetrical fore and aft and unaltered to the first order by the motion

propositions.name: kinetic_energy_decomposes
propositions.statement: The mean kinetic energy of the system consists of the internal energy of the molecule, the same as when it is at rest, together with the energy of the motions of translation of its electrons.
propositions.quote: the mean kinetic energy of the system consists of the internal energy of the molecule, which is the same as when it is at rest, together with the sum of the energies belonging to the motions of translation

propositions.name: mass_is_coefficient_of_translation_energy
propositions.statement: The coefficient of half the square of the velocity of translation is the measure of the inertia, or mass, of the molecule.
propositions.quote: The coefficient of half the square of the velocity of translation in the latter part is therefore, up to that order, the measure of the inertia, or mass, of the molecule thus constituted

propositions.name: electric_inertia_sums_electron_inertias
propositions.statement: The electric inertia of the molecule is equal to the sum of the inertias of the electrons which compose it.
propositions.quote: when the square of the ratio of the velocity of translation of the molecule to that of radiation is neglected, its electric inertia is equal to the sum of those of the electrons which compose it

propositions.name: mass_conserved_in_molecular_transformations
propositions.statement: The constancy of mass throughout molecular transformations is verified for the part of the mass that is of electric origin.
propositions.quote: the fundamental chemical law of the constancy of mass throughout molecular transformations is verified for that part of the mass (whether it be all of it or not) that is of electric origin

propositions.name: gravitation_proportional_to_mass
propositions.statement: Gravitation is proportional to mass.
propositions.quote: gravitation, which has presumably no relations with such action, is proportional to mass: it has been suggested that inertia and gravity may be different results of the same cause

propositions.name: gravitation_speed_enormously_exceeds_light
propositions.statement: The velocity of propagation of gravitation is enormously greater than the velocity of radiation.
propositions.quote: where c' is the velocity of propagation of gravitation and is enormously greater than c

propositions.name: electric_forces_prevail_over_gravitative
propositions.statement: In the constitution of the molecule, electric forces or agencies prevail enormously over gravitative ones.
propositions.quote: in the constitution of the molecule it is admitted, from electrolytic considerations, that electric forces or agencies prevail enormously over gravitative ones

propositions.name: internal_forces_electrodynamic_between_atom_electrons
propositions.statement: The internal forces of a material system arise wholly from electrodynamic actions between the systems of electrons which constitute the atoms.
propositions.quote: if the internal forces of a material system arise wholly from electrodynamic actions between the systems of electrons which constitute the atoms

propositions.name: currents_are_electron_transfer
propositions.statement: Electric currents flowing in a system involve the transfer of electrons into entirely new positions.
propositions.quote: The case is however different when there are electric currents flowing in the system, for that involves the transfer of some electrons into entirely new positions

propositions.name: conductor_structure_unaffected_by_current
propositions.statement: The mechanical structure of a conductor is not sensibly affected when it carries a current.
propositions.quote: we know in fact that the mechanical structure of a conductor is not sensibly affected when it carries a current

propositions.name: ionic_interactions_wholly_electric
propositions.statement: The actions between the ions, as usual in electrolytic theory, are assumed to be wholly electric.
propositions.quote: the actions between the ions are, as usual in electrolytic theory, assumed to be wholly electric

propositions.name: convection_diminishes_conductivity_second_order
propositions.statement: Convection changes the conductivity of the electrolyte by a unilateral amount, reversed when the direction of the current is reversed, that is at most of the second order of small quantities.
propositions.quote: This change of conductivity is a unilateral one, being reversed when the direction of the current is reversed: it is at most of the second order of small quantities

propositions.name: contraction_effect_extraordinarily_minute
propositions.statement: The elongation or contraction implied by the hypothesis is extraordinarily minute.
propositions.quote: the elongation or contraction which it implies is extraordinarily minute

propositions.name: aether_equations_linear
propositions.statement: The equations of the free aether are linear equations.
propositions.quote: The equations of the free aether, as revealed by MacCullagh's optical analysis, are linear equations

propositions.name: radiations_travel_same_speed
propositions.statement: All kinds of radiations travel with the same speed in the celestial spaces.
propositions.quote: they in fact must be so if all kinds of radiations are to travel with the same speed in the celestial spaces

propositions.name: maxwell_equations_explain_electrodynamic_optical_phenomena
propositions.statement: Maxwell's equivalent relations formed a basis for the explanation of the whole plexus of electrodynamic and optical phenomena.
propositions.quote: equivalent relations with the appropriate generalization were arrived at on the electric side, and formed a basis for the explanation of the whole plexus of electrodynamic and optical phenomena

propositions.name: linear_aether_equations_exact
propositions.statement: The simple linear equations of the aether are exact.
propositions.quote: There appears then, as yet, to be nothing to tempt us to depart from the natural prepossession, by considering the simple linear equations of the aether to be other than exact

propositions.name: stars_show_no_color_change
propositions.statement: Celestial bodies, on emerging from eclipse or occupation, show no changes of colour.
propositions.quote: celestial bodies on emerging from eclipse or occupation show no changes of colour

propositions.name: gravity_electric_inverse_square_law
propositions.statement: Gravity and electric force both obey the same law of the inverse square of the distance.
propositions.quote: gravity and electric force both obey the same law of the inverse square of the distance

propositions.name: gravitation_not_of_radiation_type
propositions.statement: Any action accounted for by non-linear aethereal terms would have relations with radiation, including a velocity of transmission of the same order as that of light.
propositions.quote: the fatal objection that any action accounted for in this way would have relations with radiation, including a velocity of transmission of the same order as that of light

propositions.name: electron_nucleus_dimensions_negligible
propositions.statement: The dimensions of the nucleus of an electron are so small, compared with the mutual distances of electrons, that these dimensions are not sensibly involved in the forces between electrons.
propositions.quote: the dimensions of the nucleus of an electron are so small, compared with the mutual distances of electrons, that these dimensions are not sensibly involved in the forces between them

propositions.name: purely_electric_atoms_lack_determinate_scale
propositions.statement: If the atoms of matter were constituted electrically, with forces wholly of electric origin, there would be nothing to determine the scale of an isolated system as regards time and space.
propositions.quote: there would be nothing to determine the scale of an isolated system as regards time and space: and different systems need not be always of the same scale of magnitude as regards their atomic structure

propositions.name: molecules_have_definite_scale
propositions.statement: The molecules of material systems have a definiteness of scale.
propositions.quote: The definiteness of scale of the molecules of material systems thus precludes the possibility of their being constituted of singularities of a uniform continuum

propositions.name: matter_more_complex_than_point_singularities
propositions.statement: The primordial stuff of matter must be made up of elements more complex than simple positional and motional singularities with nuclei devoid of sensible volume.
propositions.quote: must thus be made up of elements of type rather more complex than simple positional and motional singularities with nuclei devoid of sensible volume

propositions.name: atomic_inertia_originates_in_aether
propositions.statement: Atomic inertia other than that which comes from the aether is impossible to conceive.
propositions.quote: Atomic inertia other than that which comes from the aether in some way it seems impossible to conceive
